component.name: VST Environment
component.summary: Windows audio plugins in Linux DAWs, vendor managers included

description.p: A managed environment for Windows audio plugins on Linux. It provisions its own Wine, installs each vendor's manager application (Native Access, IK Product Manager, Steinberg Download Assistant) and the products it delivers, applies every fix those need under Wine (each one works around a decision the vendor made, not something Wine got wrong, and the app says which), and exposes the result to Linux DAWs as ordinary VST2, VST3 and CLAP plugins through yabridge — without the user ever dealing with Wine. Installed programs appear in the desktop's application menu.

Vendor support lives in modules: Native Instruments, IK Multimedia and Steinberg are built in, and a separate package can add another vendor. Vendor managers are not included: download them from the vendor (the app links to the page) and choose the file in the app. A portable Wine build is downloaded on first run.

Tested: Native Access with Kontakt 8, the IK Product Manager, and the Steinberg Download Assistant, Activation Manager and Library Manager with HALion Sonic 7, each signing in, installing products and running the plugins in a Linux DAW; FabFilter's Total Bundle, Soundtoys 5.5 with its iLok licensing, Valhalla DSP, Xfer Records' Serum 2 and Arturia's Analog Lab install as plain Windows programs and work unchanged.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Native Instruments GmbH, IK Multimedia Production srl or Steinberg Media Technologies GmbH.
Tested: Valhalla DSP and Xfer Records Serum 2 work out of the box
Tested: Soundtoys 5.5 with iLok licensing works out of the box
Deep-dive fixes, upfront vendor notes, FabFilter tested; quirks only for what an installer added
Remove nilinux's machine-wide Wine redirection when found
Compatibility notes: a little more shame, still no profanity
Blunter compatibility notes in the app and the README
Compatibility pills and notes in the app, a leaner Install page, release pages that say what to download
Steinberg support: HALion runs, sign-in persists, dialogs have text; per-plugin Direct3D; plugin crash log; new icon
vstenv: a vendor-modular environment for Windows audio plugins on Linux
First release: the vendor-modular successor to nilinux, with Native Instruments and IK Multimedia modules and desktop menu entries for installed programs
